standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 8125-8126) as a cross-chapter pointer
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides etaleness of the induced morphism of presenting schemes.

core_obligations: Representability: an open immersion of algebraic stacks is representable, hence DM by the trivial implications (proof lines 8120-8122)
Presentation: for a smooth surjective morphism from a scheme to the target, the base change of the open immersion is an open subscheme of that scheme (proof lines 8123-8125)
Etaleness of the induced morphism of schemes by the corresponding statement for schemes, and conclusion from the definition of an etale morphism of algebraic stacks (proof lines 8125-8127)
proof_roadmap: 开浸入可表示 ⇒ 由平凡蕴含关系是 DM。
取概型 X 满光滑映到 X，则 U = U ×_X X 是 X 的开子概型，U → X 在概型层面 étale。
按代数栈态射 étale 的定义即得结论。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that an open immersion of algebraic stacks is etale (author lemma at source lines 8114-8117, label lemma-open-immersion-etale). The proof (source lines 8119-8128) notes that the immersion is representable hence DM, pulls it back along a smooth surjective morphism from a scheme to get an open subscheme, applies the corresponding statement for schemes, and concludes from the definition (proof lines 8120-8127). The verification of the two defining clauses through a presentation is the content. H2.
